topic: A bad month vs a bad year

slides.headline: On Trustpilot, last month's 1-stars matter more than last year's
Your TrustScore isn't a simple average.
slides.body: Trustpilot says it gives more weight to recent reviews.

slides.headline: So timing matters.
slides.body: A burst of fake 1-stars this month drags harder than the same number spread over two years.

slides.headline: Waiting it out is slow.
slides.body: You need a steady run of new genuine reviews to outweigh them.

slides.headline: Meanwhile, it's on show.
slides.body: Every visitor this month sees the dip, not your history.

slides.headline: The time to act is while it's recent.
slides.body: That's when it's doing the most damage.

slides.headline: Send us the link. We'll tell you if it may have a case.
slides.sub: You only pay once it's gone.
